en.content:
Consider the function


where P(x) is a polynomial such that P'' (x) is always a constant and P(3) = 9. If f(x) is continuous at x = 2, then P(5) is equal to _____________.
en.explanation:
P''(x) = const. P(x) is a 2 degree polynomial

f(x) is cont. at x = 2

f(2+) = f(2)





P(x) = (x 2)(ax + b)

P(3) = (3 2)(3a + b) = 9 3a + b = 9

a = 2, b = 3

P(5) = (5 2)(2.5 + 3) = 3.13 = 39

en.content: If a + b + c = 1, ab + bc + ca = 2 and abc = 3, then the value of a<sup>4</sup> + b<sup>4</sup> + c<sup>4</sup> is equal to ______________.
en.explanation:
(a + b + c)2 = 1

a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca) = 1

a2 + b2 + c2 = – 3 ….(i)

ab + bc + ca = 2 ….(ii)

Squaring of equation (ii),

a2b2 + b2c2 + c2a2 + 2(ab2c + bc2a + ca2b) = 4

a2b2 + b2c2 + c2a2 + 2abc(a + b + c) = 4

a2b2 + b2c2 + c2a2 + 6 = 4

a2b2 + b2c2 + c2a2 = – 2 ….(iii)

Squaring of equation (i),

a4 + b4 + c4 + 2(a2b2 + b2c2 + c2a2) = 9

a4 + b4 + c4 – 4 = 9

a4 + b4 + c4 = 13

hi.content: यदि a + b + c = 1, ab + bc + ca = 2 और abc = 3 है, तो a<sup>4</sup> + b<sup>4</sup> + c<sup>4</sup> का मान ______________ है।
